verdict.rationale: Name.com offers API, SDK, webhook and MCP automation surfaces, so asking whether automations can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no versioning, change history, review workflow or rollback for automations or configuration. The sandbox environment is a separate testing environment, not versioning or rollback, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
